column1: FinTech Co - Information Security Risk Register
Fictional Fintech Organization (50 employees) | Aligned to ISO 27001 & NIST CSF | Last Reviewed: March 2026

column4: Risk Description
column13: Recommended Action

column4: Malicious encryption of systems and data demanding ransom payment
column13: Deploy EDR solution; enforce offline backups; conduct phishing simulation

column3: Customer Data Breach via Web App
column4: Exploitation of web application vulnerability exposing cardholder and PII data
column13: Conduct quarterly DAST/SAST; implement bug bounty programme

column4: Malicious or negligent employee exfiltrates sensitive customer or financial data
column13: Implement UEBA; enforce least privilege; quarterly access reviews

column4: Employee credentials stolen via phishing, enabling unauthorised system access
column11: MFA on critical systems, security awareness training
column13: Enforce MFA across all systems; deploy anti-phishing email gateway

column4: Exploitation of known CVEs in unpatched servers or applications
column13: Implement vulnerability management programme; target 14-day critical patch SLA

column4: Critical payment gateway provider suffers downtime, halting transaction processing
column11: SLA in contract, secondary processor identified
column13: Activate secondary payment processor; review SLA penalties with legal

column4: A key vendor suffers a breach exposing data shared by FinTech Co
column13: Implement TPRM programme; require SOC 2 Type II reports from critical vendors

column4: Misconfigured AWS/GCP settings expose storage buckets or services publicly
column13: Deploy CSPM tool (e.g. Wiz/Prisma); enforce infrastructure-as-code reviews

column4: Critical SaaS vendor fails to meet regulatory or data handling contractual obligations
column11: DPAs in place for key vendors
column13: Annual DPA review; align contracts with GDPR/PCI DSS obligations

column4: Critical security or IT knowledge concentrated in one or two individuals
column13: Document all critical processes; cross-train backup staff; implement succession planning

column4: Employee accidentally deletes critical database or configuration files
column13: Implement soft-delete / versioning; test restore procedures quarterly

column4: Employees unaware of security policies, leading to policy violations or incidents
column13: Move to quarterly micro-trainings; track completion; simulate phishing monthly

column4: Employees use unapproved SaaS tools storing company or customer data
column13: Deploy CASB; publish approved software catalogue; enforce policy with HR

column3: Data Centre / Primary Cloud Region Failure
column4: Primary hosting environment becomes unavailable due to outage or disaster
column13: Design multi-region active-passive architecture; test failover bi-annually

column4: Backup processes fail silently; data unrecoverable during incident
column13: Implement backup monitoring with alerts; schedule quarterly restore tests

column4: BCP exists on paper but has never been exercised; real invocation likely to fail
column13: Conduct tabletop exercise within 90 days; schedule annual full DR test

column4: Office or co-location facility loses power or connectivity for extended period
column13: Document remote-work fallback procedure; consider cloud-first migration

column4: Internal or external APIs expose excessive data or lack proper authentication
column13: Implement OAuth 2.0 / API gateway; conduct annual API security review

column4: Unvetted open-source library contains malicious code or critical CVE
column13: Integrate SCA tool (e.g. Snyk/Dependabot) into CI/CD pipeline

column4: Admin accounts used without oversight; excessive privileges granted and not revoked
column13: Implement PAM solution; enforce just-in-time access; quarterly privilege reviews
